findings.summary: The exclusive lock is written before both database handles are constructed, while construction occurs before the try/finally. A construction-time failure can leave a lock without a sanitized failure result and can leave an already-created handle outside cleanup.
The helper checks an admission status and source pins but does not require exact accepted independent route and finite-guard QA receipt pins or their verdict fields before creating the lock.

disposition: Preserve candidate1 as rejected. Review a repaired helper only after it covers construction failures and binds exact independently accepted route and finite-guard receipts before lock creation.
